params.name: q
params.description: Full-text search query. Supports AND, OR, NOT operators.

params.name: query-fields
params.description: Specify which indexed fields are used by the q parameter (e.g., headline, body, all)

params.name: section
params.description: Filter by section ID (e.g., technology, sport). Use | for OR, - prefix to exclude.

params.name: tag
params.description: Filter by tag ID (e.g., technology/apple). Use comma for AND, | for OR, - to exclude.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by content type

params.name: from-date
params.description: Return content published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: to-date
params.description: Return content published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: order-by
params.description: Sort order for results

params.name: show-fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of article fields to include (e.g., body,headline,thumbnail,shortUrl,byline,trailText,wordcount,starRating,all)

params.name: show-tags
params.description: Comma-separated list of tag types to include (e.g., keyword,contributor,series,blog,tone,type,all)

params.name: show-elements
params.description: Include media elements (image, video, audio, all)

params.name: show-blocks
params.description: Include block-level content (body, all, main)

params.name: show-references
params.description: Include references

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination

params.name: page-size
params.description: Number of results per page (max 50 for free tier)

params.name: use-date
params.description: Which date to use for filtering and ordering

params.name: lang
params.description: ISO language code to filter content by language

params.name: star-rating
params.description: Filter by star rating (for reviews)

params.name: production-office
params.description: Filter by production office

items.docs: Search all Guardian content. Returns articles, liveblogs, galleries, and other content types matching the query. Results are paginated and can be filtered by section, tag, date range, and more.

params.name: contentId
params.description: The ID (path) of the content item (e.g., world/2024/jan/01/article-slug)

params.name: show-fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include

params.name: show-tags
params.description: Comma-separated list of tag types to include

params.name: show-elements
params.description: Include media elements

params.name: show-blocks
params.description: Include block-level content

params.name: show-references
params.description: Include references

items.docs: Retrieve a specific content item by its ID path (e.g., technology/2024/jan/01/article-slug).
